_comment: Each problem is a general, real-world engineering problem. Descriptions describe the problem class, never a specific student's project, so nothing is invented about individual projects. A project links to every problem whose rules match its corrected title: at least one 'any' pattern, all 'requires' patterns, and no 'excludes' pattern.

problems.title: Distribution transformer failures
problems.description: Distribution transformers fail from overheating, overloading, oil degradation, oil theft and poor earthing. Failures are expensive and cause long outages, so utilities need early warning of developing faults.

problems.title: Faults and remote switching on power lines and substations
problems.description: When a fault occurs on a line or substation, crews often patrol long distances to find it and switch by hand. Remote monitoring, fault location and remote switching shorten outages.

problems.title: Customers unaware of power outages
problems.description: Consumers and utilities often learn about outages late. Automatic outage alerts improve response times and customer communication.

problems.title: Managing limited power with load shedding and prioritisation
problems.description: When supply or backup capacity is limited, essential loads must keep running while non-critical loads are shed. Doing this manually is slow and error-prone.

problems.title: Poor power quality: power factor, harmonics and voltage problems
problems.description: Low power factor, harmonics, voltage sags, phase imbalance and wrong phase sequence waste energy, raise bills and damage equipment, especially in industry.
any: auto selection of any available phase

problems.title: Fair, accurate electricity metering and billing
problems.description: Shared meters in multi-tenant buildings, tampering, credit management and unclear consumption make electricity billing unfair or inaccurate.

problems.title: High and invisible energy consumption
problems.description: Homes, offices and facilities rarely see where their energy goes. Monitoring and automatic control help reduce waste and cost.
any: control and monitoring of electrical energy

problems.title: Energy access from renewable and waste sources
problems.description: Off-grid and unreliable-grid areas need affordable local generation. Solar, wind, hydro, biomass and energy harvesting can supply or supplement power.
any: mobile phone charging by using solar

problems.title: Reliable backup power and source switching
problems.description: Grid interruptions force switching between grid, generator, solar and batteries. Slow or unsafe changeover disrupts sensitive loads such as hospitals and data centres.
any: switching electronic circuit of solar and electrical

problems.title: Fuel losses: consumption, theft, leakage and contamination
problems.description: Generator sites, fuel stations and transport fleets lose money through inefficient running, theft, leaks and contaminated fuel.

problems.title: Efficient power conversion for solar, batteries and drives
problems.description: Solar systems, batteries, motors and chargers depend on inverters and converters. Their efficiency, protection and control determine how well the whole system performs.

problems.title: Charging and managing electric vehicles
problems.description: Electric bikes, tricycles and cars are growing in Tanzania, but charging infrastructure, battery management and charging billing are still limited.

problems.title: Electrical installation safety
problems.description: Faulty wiring, fake cables, poor earthing, lightning surges and unsafe maintenance cause shocks, fires and equipment damage.

problems.title: Equipment and motor breakdowns
problems.description: Motors and industrial equipment fail from overload, vibration, overheating and phase problems. Without condition monitoring and planned maintenance, breakdowns cause costly downtime.

problems.title: Faulty and wasteful street lighting
problems.description: Street lights fail unnoticed or stay on unnecessarily, which reduces road safety and wastes energy.

problems.title: Unsafe drinking and process water
problems.description: Contaminated, salty or hard water harms health and equipment. Affordable monitoring and treatment are needed where laboratory testing is far away.

problems.title: Water supply, pumping and leakage
problems.description: Utilities and buildings struggle with burst pipes, overflowing tanks, unreliable supply and inefficient pumping, which wastes water and energy.

problems.title: Water metering and billing
problems.description: Shared connections and inaccurate meters make water billing unfair, and air in pipes can make meters read wrongly.

problems.title: Inefficient irrigation water use
problems.description: Manual irrigation wastes water and labour and gives crops uneven moisture. Automatic, sensor-driven and solar-powered irrigation can improve yields.

problems.title: Sanitation, sewage and wastewater
problems.description: Overflowing septic tanks, poor toilet hygiene and wasted grey water create health risks and lost resources.

problems.title: Post-harvest losses: drying and storage
problems.description: Crops, fish and fruit spoil quickly without good drying, cooling and storage. Smallholders lose a large share of their harvest after it leaves the field.

problems.title: Livestock, poultry and aquaculture management
problems.description: Poultry, fish and bee farmers need stable temperature, humidity, water quality and disease control. Manual care is labour-intensive and losses are high.

problems.title: Protecting crops, stores and homes from pests and animals
problems.description: Rodents, insects, mosquitoes, birds of prey and wild animals destroy crops and stores and spread disease.

problems.title: Soil fertility and crop monitoring
problems.description: Farmers often apply fertiliser and plant without knowing soil nutrients, moisture or growing conditions, which lowers yields and wastes inputs.

problems.title: Mechanising small-scale food processing
problems.description: Peeling, roasting, milling, sorting and cutting are often done by hand, which is slow, inconsistent and unhygienic.

problems.title: Patient monitoring and medication adherence
problems.description: Understaffed facilities and home-based patients need help with vital-sign monitoring, medication reminders and safe handling of samples and medicines.

problems.title: Independence for people with disabilities
problems.description: People with visual, hearing, speech or mobility impairments face barriers in moving, communicating and voting independently.

problems.title: Road accidents and driver behaviour
problems.description: Speeding, drunk or drowsy driving, glare, poor pedestrian crossings and slow emergency response contribute to road deaths.

problems.title: Railway safety and reliability
problems.description: Rail networks, including the new SGR, need reliable track, signalling, crossing and traction-power monitoring to prevent derailments and delays.

problems.title: Vehicle theft, tracking and condition
problems.description: Vehicle owners need protection against theft and early warning of faults such as low fuel, overheating and missed maintenance.

problems.title: Parking, ticketing and passenger services
problems.description: Parking, ferries, buses and airports suffer from queues, overloading, manual fare collection and poor passenger information.

problems.title: Intrusion, theft and access control
problems.description: Homes, server rooms, workshops and businesses need affordable ways to control access and detect intruders.

problems.title: Examination cheating and identity fraud
problems.description: Phones, impersonation and manual checks undermine fairness in examination halls.

problems.title: Fire and hazardous gas leaks
problems.description: LPG, chlorine dioxide and other gas leaks and electrical fires can cause deaths and destroy property if not detected early.

problems.title: Safety and productivity in mining
problems.description: Underground and small-scale miners face gas, collapse and flooding hazards and use inefficient processing methods.

problems.title: Worker safety on sites
problems.description: Construction, telecom and industrial workers face injuries when protective equipment is missing or hazards go unnoticed.

problems.title: Comfort and automation in buildings
problems.description: Air conditioning, ventilation, lighting, lifts and appliances are often manually controlled, which wastes energy and limits accessibility.

problems.title: Affordable, clean cooking
problems.description: Charcoal and firewood cooking harms health and forests. Electric, solar and induction cooking can be cleaner if they are affordable.

problems.title: Solid waste collection and recycling
problems.description: Overflowing bins, unsorted waste and limited recycling create health hazards and lose recoverable materials.

problems.title: Air and noise pollution
problems.description: Urban dust, vehicle emissions, kitchen fumes and noise affect health but are rarely measured locally.

problems.title: Emergency response and early warning
problems.description: Communities need early warning of floods and severe weather, and faster emergency response when accidents happen.

problems.title: Automating industrial processes
problems.description: Factories, ports and plants still rely on manual handling, inspection and dosing, which limits throughput, consistency and safety.

problems.title: Hands-on training equipment for technical education
problems.description: Technical institutions lack affordable laboratory kits, so students learn practical skills from theory alone.

problems.title: Cashless payment and automated vending
problems.description: Cash handling, queues and manual sales slow down retail, fuel and banking services.

problems.title: Information, queues and services on campus
problems.description: Libraries, registration, notices and voting on campus often depend on manual processes and paper.

problems.title: Power and safety at telecom sites and data centres
problems.description: Remote BTS towers and data centres depend on generators and batteries. Outages, fuel theft and unsafe maintenance raise costs.

problems.title: Wildlife monitoring and conservation
problems.description: Parks and guides need to know where wildlife is and protect it from conflict with people and infrastructure, using limited staff over large areas.

problems.title: Bringing electricity to unserved villages, islands and schools
problems.description: Many villages, islands and rural institutions are far from the national grid. Extending lines, building mini-grids or using local generation each has different costs and technical limits.

problems.title: Controlling phone use where it is unsafe or disruptive
problems.description: Phones cause cheating in exams, distraction while driving and security risks in banks. Detection, muting and jamming each raise different technical and legal questions.
